Varanasi Ropeway Fares Approved for Cantonment-Godowlia Route

Fares for the new Varanasi ropeway connecting Cantonment and Godowlia have been approved. The journey is expected to take approximately 15 minutes. This development aims to improve connectivity and reduce travel time within the city.
